body:
Hi,
I‘ve seen in the documentation for the e2e challenge that the policy capability score on the leaderboard is computed with an IRT-based weighting. 
But I couldn‘t find documentation about which metrics are actually used as input to the weighting. Could you share information which metrics are relevant to compute the score?

Thanks!

comments.body:
I assume you mean that you saw the link on the HF space page to https://ln2697.github.io/navhard-leaderboard-2/docs/ ?

But, in terms of the score that we are using and the IRT algorithm, the input to the IRT is a per-rollout "score" ( https://github.com/NVlabs/alpasim/blob/e2e_challenge/src/eval/src/eval/aggregation/scene_score.py#L75 ) and the configured IRT algorithm is currently zoib (a continuous Beta-IRT variant), applied uniformly to all eligible submissions. See https://github.com/kesai-labs/drive-irt for the implementation.

I'll work on clarifying this in the documentation soon. Thanks!

title: [E2E challenge] Relevant metric(s) for Policy Capability Score
